preconditions: Explicit display label and fill colour for every unit
decisionLogic: Fill the viewport with a neutral UNKNOWN background.
Render one polygon per contiguous run having at least two samples bounded above and below by evidence.
Do not connect coloured polygons across an unknown sample gap.
Show an isolated supported sample as a marker, not an area polygon.
exclusions: No implicit lithology colour or label
validationMethod: Two-run unknown-gap image, missing-style and display-bound tests
reopenCondition: Vector/DWG rendering, uncertainty bands, fault domains or publication layouts are added
